description: Single committed, version-controlled artifact recording the dashboard-seed-run Cloud Run Job task-timeout hardening (spec dashboard-data-activation Req 5.1, 5.2). The one-shot Seed_Job (dist/ops/seed-run/main.js) backfills hosted candles/vectors then resolves historical outcomes; its clean run was being terminated at the previous 3600s task-timeout as outcome writes finished. This artifact raises --task-timeout into the 5400-7200s range so a clean run completes before the limit, and makes that timeout reproducible from version control. Every live command below is operator-approved under the Live Cloud Execution Protocol (Req 9): target reconciled first, exact command shown before run, secrets sourced by name from Secret_Manager only (never echoed/logged/committed/argv). The re-run relies on the existing idempotent (Asset, Date) upserts so it adds no duplicate rows and performs no re-seed of unchanged data (Req 5.4).
artifactApproachLabel: committed configuration recording the operator-approved commands
